gripOrHq.title: Little Black Box
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Prevent up to 1 Net or brain damage each turn. Put [1] from the bank on Little Black Box when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for increasing your link. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: Finders Keepers
gripOrHq.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: Do the 'Drine
gripOrHq.rulesText: Suffer any amount of brain damage, but not enough to flatline you or to reduce your hand size to less than 0. Gain [4] for each point of brain damage you suffer in this way. This damage cannot be prevented.

gripOrHq.title: Library Search
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on R&D or HQ. If run is successful, access two additional cards if you used no noisy icebreakers during the run and if no trace attempts were made during the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Library Search
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D or HQ. If run is successful, access two additional cards if you used no noisy icebreakers during the run and if no trace attempts were made during the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Meat Upgrade
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove up to two tags, at no cost, and draw three cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Executive File Clerk
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [2],[T]: Look at all cards stored in HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Networking
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: MS-todon
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.

rig.title: Crash Space
rig.rulesText: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns. All trace attempts are automatically successful, and give you a tag in addition to their other effects. If Crash Space leaves play, lose [2]. A: Trash Crash Space. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

root.title: Antiquated Interface Routines
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has +1 strength.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

root.title: Data Masons
root.rulesText: Cost to rez walls is reduced by [2]. All walls have +1 strength.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
